name: LOLBin Outbound Network Connection
description: Detects network connection established by administrative utilities that should not normally communicate externally (certutil, cmd, rundll32, regsvr32, vssadmin).
explanation: Living-off-the-Land Binaries initiating direct external connections typically represent payload download or C2 check-in.
investigation_steps: Review the full command line of the originating utility.
Inspect destination IP address and port.
Correlate FIM changes to see if a file was written to disk.
